paragraphs.text: Aliban was a goblin wizard and personal attendant to Koskun Keep 's first goblin king, Crank .

When Crank was summoned away by a planeswalker , and Aliban was the only survivor of the Goblin upper class to survive the Great War, he thus became the second goblin king. He created Aliban's Towers , and his descendants also learned the spell.
Given that hundreds of years have passed since his natural lifetime, it is likely that Aliban is long dead.
